exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

effects.elite_and_boss_handling: globally resisted stagger duration and immunity-window behavior

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: the later, harder-to-reach targets receive the strongest disruption

rules.text: The first target is staggered for 0.25 s and each successive chain step adds 0.05 s, capped at 0.60 s.
Elites and bosses receive globally resisted stagger duration and immunity-window behavior.
Damage and target cap are unchanged. The later, harder-to-reach targets receive the strongest disruption.
